crossRefs.note: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

translations.web: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
translations.bsb: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty of sin.
translations.kjv: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin
translations.asv: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
